SQL rolling a cell-sorted species table up to a coarser resolution

Source: R/species.R
obis_h3_species_rollup_sql.Rd

One row per (cell at res, aphiaid) from a finer species table with the columns of species_flat/res=<r>.parquet: n summed, year_min the least and year_max the greatest over the finer cells (NULL only when every finer row's year is NULL), name_key carried (one per aphiaid). This is the atlas's sumBySpecies over a cell's children, written once in the release; it equals obis_h3_species_sql() at res straight from the store, since that rolls the same occ_h3 tier up with the same sums, minima and maxima.

Usage

obis_h3_species_rollup_sql(from, res)

Arguments

from

a table name or a table function such as read_parquet('species_flat/res=3.parquet'), with cell_id, name_key, aphiaid, n, year_min and year_max.

res

the coarser H3 resolution (0 to 15; coarser than from's).

Value

a SQL string (a SELECT, unordered) with the columns cell_id, name_key, aphiaid, n, year_min, year_max.

Examples

cat(obis_h3_species_rollup_sql("read_parquet('species_flat/res=3.parquet')", 1))
#> SELECT CAST(h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, 1) AS BIGINT) AS cell_id,
#>        name_key::INTEGER AS name_key, aphiaid::BIGINT AS aphiaid, SUM(n)::BIGINT AS n,
#>        MIN(year_min)::SMALLINT AS year_min, MAX(year_max)::SMALLINT AS year_max
#> FROM read_parquet('species_flat/res=3.parquet')
#> GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
